text: こんな　ところで　あぶら　うってて　いいのか！

patterns.name: 〜ていい
patterns.explanation: A て-form followed by いい says that doing it is okay. Here うってて is short for うっていて, 'being in the middle of selling'. うってて　いい = 'okay to be loafing'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: うってて is the contracted form of うっていて, where ている shows something going on right now. あぶら　うってて = 'being busy loafing around'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end makes a pointed question that asks for an explanation, often scolding. いいのか = 'is that really okay?'.
